regions.today: It will remain dry and sunny this evening and feeling very warm or hot in most places. Feeling cooler along eastern coasts, as a moderate easterly breeze continues.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with plenty of clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 16 degrees in light northerly or variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Another dry, warm and sunny day tomorrow, though the sunshine may turn hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 24 to 29 degrees. Cooler along eastern coasts. All in a light mostly northeast breeze.
